pretreatments.description: Ultrasonic pre-treatment was conducted using an ultrasonic homogeniser (Bandelin-Sonopuls HD 3400) with parameters including a frequency of 20 kHz, 70% amplitude, and 200 W power. Samples were ultrasonicated for either 15 minutes (achieving specific energy of 15,000 kJ/kg TS) or 30 minutes (achieving specific energy of 25,000 kJ/kg TS).

Microwave thermal disintegration was applied using a Microwave Digestion Unit (Berghoff Speedwave MWS-3+) via a staged temperature profile. The treatment was performed for 30 minutes at a temperature of 175 °C and a pressure of 2000 kPa.
